args.body: Use WELFARE-ELIGIBLE-CASE-OPERATOR-CARD to produce one copy-ready handoff for the next real eligible request. First check current mission state and committed inventory for an equivalent card, including the same-batch read-only inventory if available. Reuse an equivalent artifact. Otherwise read the actual terms, corrected bilingual rehearsal, independent lot check, acceptance verdict, private-cycle contract and payment instructions. Give the operator a go/no-go decision for each step: documented eligibility, exact terms hash and CAD 49 scope, current official notice inclusion and hash evidence from the authorized case, inline delivery and its receipt, administrative acceptance, founder-confirmed deposit and Treasury posting. Follow the documented order of operations. Where the contract leaves case-local source inclusion unresolved, require the minimum redacted case evidence before promising source-dependent work. Save and read the card under products/services/welfare-tender/. Verify its decisions against one fictional eligible request with the source missing, stopping before any unsupported promise or order step. Close under a valid lease with the checked evidence and a lesson. Keep customer details, private mail, test sends, register operations and public changes outside this task. Preserve the November 20 checkpoint, December 4 17:00 UTC retirement and the independent publication gate.

description: Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so eligible demand is unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
